LanguageData.Gun_Fal_50_61_RWP.description: The FN FAL 50.61 is a selective-fire battle rifle known for its robust construction and reliable performance. Chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO, it delivers powerful shots at moderate range with commendable accuracy. Its folding-stock design improves portability without sacrificing stability, making it a versatile choice for combat scenarios requiring both mobility and firepower.
